About INPACK FABRICATIONS

Engineering Excellence in Packaging Machines Since 2004

Based in IDA Cherlapalli, Hyderabad, INPACK FABRICATIONS PVT. LTD. (IFPL) is an ISO 9001:2015 certified manufacturer specializing in automatic form, fill, and seal machinery.

Guided by our slogan "commitment to excellence", we manufacture precision machinery tailored for powders, granules, seeds, and snacks. Every machine is engineered for high operational uptime, low maintenance, and exact fill weight consistency.

Superior Quality

Heavy-duty food-grade SS304/316 metallurgy

Pinpoint Accuracy

Microprocessor load cell and servo dosing

Dedicated Service

Prompt nationwide field service & spare parts support

Competitive Price

Direct OEM manufacturer pricing advantages

CHERLAPALLI MANUFACTURING UNIT

Hyderabad, Telangana, India

Our fully integrated manufacturing unit in IDA Cherlapalli houses CAD design stations, precision fabrication tools, component assembly lines, and pre-dispatch testing bays.

Certifications ISO 9001:2015 Certified
Core Expertise Automatic VFFS & Weigh Fillers

Servo Auger Filler Powder Packaging · 10g to 1000g Fill

Auger Filler Machine

High-precision vertical auger filler system engineered specifically for non-free-flowing fine powders. Uses servo screw dosing for accurate batch filling.

Key Applications:

Spices Wheat Flour Coffee Powder Pharmaceuticals Chemicals
Machine Price ₹13,00,000
Rotary Cup Filler Granule Packaging · Volumetric Dosing

Rotary Cup Filler Machine

High-speed volumetric cup filling machine ideal for free-flowing granular products. Features telescopic cups for quick weight changeovers.

Key Applications:

Rice & Pulses Sugar & Salt Seeds Dalia & Sooji Tea Granules
Machine Price ₹11,00,000
